title: Plynth modular kit layout, version 1
description: Written by Plynth as export/<Stem>_Kit_layout.json next to the kit FBX (core/include/plynth/core/Kit.h). It lists every unique kit piece and every place a copy of one goes. Coordinates are Blender world metres: X = plan x, Y = -plan y, Z up from the first floor's level, the same origin as every exported FBX. Rotations are degrees about Z, anticlockwise seen from above.

kit_file.description: The kit FBX in the same folder.

floors.description: Every floor with walls, in plan order, with the grid its walls were cut on: the project's grid size, so it is the same for every floor.

pieces.description: Sorted by id. Each piece is stored in one frame, picked the same way whichever wall or direction finds it (Kit.h rules 8 and 9). So its origin is not always at the first end along its wall and its X does not always point toward the wall's to point. The placements say where each copy goes and how it is turned.

mesh.description: The mesh name in the kit FBX.

wall.description: The wall a wall, opening or curved piece comes from; null for corners.

point.description: The plan point at a corner's origin; null otherwise.

location.description: Where the piece's origin goes. Use it as it is: it cannot be worked out from the wall's ends.

rotation_z_degrees.description: The turn of the piece's X from world X. Use it as it is: it can be half a turn from the wall's own direction.
